title: Insulin Pump Program Computation Standard: Cartridge and Reservoir Refill Quantity
content:
**C-1 Item and scope.** The cartridge or reservoir item of an Insulin Pump Program refill is the A4232 reservoir for a MiniMed 780G and the A4225 cartridge for every other model. For a cartridge or reservoir refill, and only for such a refill, the cartridges shipped are the covered cartridges plus the noticed cartridges worked out below, in the cartridge or reservoir item the pump model uses; every other supply line of the program remains under the general quantity rule. For such a refill, and only for such a refill, the supply days are the refill's 30-day blocks times 30; an infusion-set refill keeps the supply days its own refill rule sets, and every other refill of the program keeps the general supply-days rule.

**C-2 Standard refill period.** The standard refill period is the tier's supply days per shipment divided by 30, giving the refill's 30-day blocks.

**C-3 Ordered rate and cartridge rate.** The standard ordered rate is the quantity per 30 days on the written order the newest authorization grant for the cartridge item rests on. The standard cartridge rate is the ordered rate.

**C-4 Pump insulin.** The customer's pump insulin is the insulin dispensed under the customer's active insulin pharmacy program whose delivery method is insulin pump, counted in the standard way from its J1817 dispensing, each billing unit holding 50 units of insulin (the pump insulin unit insulin). The daily pump insulin is, in the standard way, the pump insulin dispensed in the three months before the ship date divided by the supply days those dispensings cover, and zero when nothing was dispensed in that time. The usable fill per cartridge is the Mobi fill of 200 units for a Tandem Mobi, the iLet fill of 160 units for a Beta Bionics iLet and the standard fill of 300 units for every other model.

**C-5 Month windows.** A dispensing or a written order counts as in the three or six months before the ship date when its date is later than the same day of the month three or six months before the ship date, and a record counts as in any other number of months before the ship date when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before the ship date.

**C-6 Covered rate.** The covered rate follows the authorization being drawn in three cases: where the newest authorization grant for the cartridge item is a payer prior authorization, the covered rate is that prior authorization's rate, its units authorized times 30 divided by the days its span covers with both ends included, rounded down; where the newest grant rests on the written order itself and an over-limit justification record dated in the 12 months before the ship date is on file, the covered rate is the written order's quantity; otherwise the covered rate is the tier's reservoirs per 30 days.

**C-7 Covered, above-coverage and noticed cartridges.** The covered cartridges are the lesser of the cartridge rate and the covered rate, times the refill's 30-day blocks. The cartridges above coverage are the cartridge rate less the covered rate, never below zero, times the refill's 30-day blocks. The noticed cartridges are the lesser of the cartridges above coverage and the units of the newest liability notice for the cartridge item when that notice was signed after the program's previous refill of that item, and none otherwise. The noticed cartridges are fixed only after the cartridge item carries a liability notice signed after the program's previous refill of that item.

**C-8 Cartridges shipped.** The cartridges shipped are the covered cartridges plus the noticed cartridges, never more than the program's authorized units remaining.

**C-9 Standard computation.** In the standard computation the cartridge rate is the standard ordered rate, the covered cartridges are the lesser of that rate and the covered rate times the standard refill period's 30-day blocks, the cartridges above coverage are that rate less the covered rate, never below zero, times those blocks, and the cartridges shipped are the covered cartridges plus the noticed cartridges, never more than the program's authorized units remaining.

**C-10 Combination.** Any adjustment to these standard figures changes the standard figure it names, replacements before limits; the covered cartridges, the cartridges above coverage, the noticed cartridges and the cartridges shipped are then figured from the cartridge rate and the refill's 30-day blocks as clauses C-7 and C-8 state.

## Standard computation worked through (hypothetical Tandem t:slim X2 program; tier shipping 90 days with 10 cartridges per 30 days; the newest grant rests on a written order of 15 per 30 days; no over-limit justification)

| Quantity | Figure |
|---|---|
| 30-day blocks | 90 divided by 30, which is 3 |
| Cartridge rate | 15 |
| Covered rate | 10 |
| Covered cartridges | the lesser of 15 and 10, times 3, which is 30 |
| Cartridges above coverage | 15 less 10, times 3, which is 15 |
| Newest A4225 notice signed after the previous refill, 15 units | noticed cartridges 15 |
| Cartridges shipped (authorized units remaining 60) | 30 plus 15, which is 45 |
| Same program with no notice signed since the previous refill | 30 |
